purpose: Diagnose external fold0; select one decoder on fold1; open fold2 only after selecting. All base predictions exclude the held match.
selection: Highest mean spellF1 on fold1 subject to macroF1 >= baseline - 0.002. Confirm selected method on fold2; adopt only if both game means improve and macro does not fall > .002.
limitation: All six games have been used in earlier architecture development; this is a new-round holdout, not untouched data.
